notes:
Requested printed test statistics retained as effect values. Replication also prints Cohen’s f = 0.10, 95% CI [0.04, 0.17]. Authors describe the target replication signal as inconsistent with the original because its magnitude was smaller (pp. 10–11); the successful label records their explicit support for the social-distance hypothesis, not a significance-based inference. Their paper-wide verdict is mixed, which covers other hypotheses. Replication p. 10 pools temporal conditions in a combined design, whereas the original target contrast concerns current assessments; target_match is therefore false for the located replication test. Original analytic n is null: only the all-condition undergraduate n is printed, and no sample size was derived from degrees of freedom. Quotes preserve PDF text extraction glyphs; whitespace has been normalized. Both cached full texts were retrieved through public author-hosted links and titles verified.
Completion source review (es_value_o): The Study 1 undergraduate actor–observer comparison directly matches friends versus present self; preserve printed F statistic, as requested.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Exact p = .008 is printed for the same F(1, 61) = 7.42 friends versus present-self comparison.
Completion source review (n_r): Final group Ns explicitly attached to critical ANOVA; mutually exclusive under random assignment. Pooled temporal design documented; participant role and exclusions recorded.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Requested printed test statistic F for total-trait social-distance follow-up ANOVA, explicitly mapped by authors to Study 1 hypothesis 1a. Replication pools temporal conditions, as recorded in notes.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Exact printed p for same univariate ANOVA as F (1, 876) = 9.02.
Completion source review (reported_success): Mixed effect-specific narrative verdict: signal detected, magnitude inconsistent and smaller. Vocabulary coding follows explicit authors’ evaluation.
